n, m, answer = map(int, input().split())
import math

gcd_value = math.gcd(n, m)
n //= gcd_value
m //= gcd_value

delta = 1.0
epsilon = 1e-10

current_x = 0
current_y = 1
best_x = 0
best_y = 1

for current_y in range(1, answer + 1):
    while abs(delta * n / m - delta * current_x / current_y) > abs(delta * n / m - delta * (current_x + 10000) / current_y):
        current_x += 10000
    while abs(delta * n / m - delta * current_x / current_y) + epsilon > abs(delta * n / m - delta * (current_x + 1) / current_y):
        current_x += 1
    if abs(delta * n / m - delta * current_x / current_y) < abs(delta * n / m - delta * best_x / best_y):
        best_x = current_x
        best_y = current_y

result_x = max(0, best_x - (1 if m == 2 and best_x != n else 0))
print(f"{result_x}/{best_y}")
